overall: The AG found a violation for failing to announce at the start of a November 2012 meeting that it was being recorded, ordered future compliance, found no violation for discussing an unnoticed topic, and declined to review a complaint-response allegation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair failed to announce at the start of the meeting that it was being recorded, after the complainant had given notice of recording.
Complainant alleged the committee discussed a school district budget topic not listed on the meeting notice, which only listed a budget forecast model review.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee did not violate the Law when it discussed a topic that was not included in the notice for its November 14, 2012 meeting.

allegations.summary: On review, complainant alleged the committee did not comply with the Open Meeting Law in responding to the complaint filed with it.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the additional allegation because it is beyond the scope of the original complaint filed with the public body.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (the chair must announce recordings at the start of open sessions).
remedy_passage: We therefore order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and
